evaluator_expectations: Assess the soundness and credibility of the proposed approach and its potential to advance the state of the art in AI agent architectures, planning, memory management, reasoning, and multi-agent frameworks
Evaluate the clarity and pertinence of the project's objectives and how well they address the call's scientific and technological ambition (TRL 2 to TRL 5 advancement)
Assess the quality and originality of the proposed methodology, including the extent to which it builds on and goes beyond existing knowledge and prior funded actions
Evaluate the credibility of the proposed innovation activities and the extent to which they demonstrate scientific excellence
Assess whether the work plan is coherent and whether the proposed research design is appropriate to achieve the stated objectives
Evaluate the quality and complementarity of the interdisciplinary approach where applicable
Assess the expected outcomes and how the proposal contributes to the Apply AI Strategy and the broader EU AI ecosystem
Evaluate the proposal's plan for linkage to AI Factories and European Digital Innovation Hubs (EDIHs)
Assess the quality and credibility of the plan for cohesion activities with ADRA and the GenAI4EU Hub
Evaluate the extent to which the proposal addresses portfolio coverage across the required sectors: healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and in-vehicle autonomous driving
Assess the measures proposed to maximise impact, including dissemination, exploitation, and communication activities
Evaluate the potential for the results to be taken up and scaled beyond the project lifetime
Assess the contribution to EU competitiveness and strategic autonomy in AI
Assess the coherence and effectiveness of the work plan, including the allocation of tasks and resources
Evaluate the quality and relevance of the proposed qualitative and quantitative KPIs and benchmarking mechanisms
Assess the adequacy of the progress monitoring mechanisms and milestone structure
Evaluate the appropriateness of the management structure and procedures, including risk management
Assess the complementarity and quality of the consortium, including the extent to which partners bring the necessary expertise and capacity
Evaluate whether the proposal builds on and reuses public results from previous funded actions where appropriate
Assess the appropriateness of the budget allocation relative to the objectives and work plan
